The analysis failed due to incorrect assumption values and formatting mismatches in the final summary report.
test_metadata_and_schema failed because 'runs_per_year_bulk_kit' was 12 instead of 24, and an extra 'carrier_cost_rule' was present. test_summary_requirements failed an assertion because the formatted value '-7,106.39' (with comma) was not found in the summary text containing '-7106.39'. Avoid including extra metadata fields not in the schema and ensure numeric formatting in the markdown summary matches the expected comma-separated currency style.
